search_policy.sources: Primary papers, publisher or official conference records, and official artifacts only.
search_policy.access_rule: State exactly which primary text was inspected. A failed build, unavailable frontend, or inaccessible full text does not establish a method limitation.
search_policy.absence_rule: The matrix does not authorize first-ever or exhaustive-absence claims.
search_policy.execution_boundary: No external comparator was installed or run for Step 18; D2-06B preserves prior native or construction dispositions.

current_contribution: A bounded exposed-development E1 diagnostic interface plus separately sealed mechanical identity, authorization-boundary, and typed-extraction prototypes. Gate A is INCONCLUSIVE, all prototype effective outcomes are UNKNOWN, and no comparative capability is established.
proposed_contribution: Automatic artifact-derived discovery and automatic E4 validation of a relational proof-to-execution authorization mismatch, under equal-information comparisons and supported independent transfer. This remains unresolved.

works.name: ZKAP
works.title: Practical Security Analysis of Zero-Knowledge Proof Circuits
actual_overlap: Builds a Circuit Dependence Graph for Circom programs and expresses semantic vulnerability patterns as queries.

Explicitly treats a completely unused public input as dangerous because proof verification can accept a different value; this directly overlaps producer-side unused-public-input or R-BIND-style detection.
assumptions_and_inputs: A native language mismatch is an applicability issue, not an algorithmic miss.
A fair adapted comparison must validate any Circom/Noir translation and charge its effort.
works.artifact_status: Official artifact repository inspected; not executed in Step 18.
works.unresolved_gap: The inspected paper does not itself establish a Solidity consumer extraction, but this does not prove that ZKAP or a straightforward extension cannot supply a cross-boundary diagnostic.
works.prohibited_inference: Do not claim unused-public-input detection, circuit dependency analysis, or application-impact motivation as new.

minimal_distinguishing_experiment.question: Does consumer information change a diagnosis in a way the fixed circuit-only result cannot?
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.design: Hold one producer and unbound public word fixed. Pair it with two consumers: one commits a protected effect from the word and one does not. Give every arm the same mapping facts and either run ZKAP on a validated native equivalent or mark and charge the adaptation. Score producer signal, effect localization, irrelevant warnings, specification effort, and E1-to-E4 outcome separately.
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.distinguishing_outcome: A predeclared consumer-specific effect/state association changes while the circuit and circuit-only output remain fixed. This would show added information, not novelty by itself.

works.name: CIVER
works.title: Scalable Verification of Zero-Knowledge Protocols
works.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2024
actual_overlap: Uses modular transformation and deduction rules to verify properties of circuit signals over polynomial equations in a prime field.
The public artifact documents weak-safety or determinism checks, tag specifications, and explicit preconditions and postconditions.
Provides a strong comparison for modular reasoning and expressive circuit specifications.
assumptions_and_inputs: The inspected artifact is Circom-focused and lists R1CS, PLONK, and ACIR support as future work.
CIVER can receive expressive user specifications; every property, annotation, and adapter must be included in the information and effort budget.
Native frontend incompatibility is not a method failure.
works.full_text_status: IEEE publisher metadata/abstract inspected; publisher full text was not retrieved in the bounded audit.
works.artifact_status: Official artifact repository inspected; not executed in Step 18.
works.unresolved_gap: A fair comparison must encode the same language-neutral relational property and compare specification effort; saying only that CIVER is circuit-focused is insufficient.
works.prohibited_inference: Do not claim modular verification, rich circuit specifications, pre/postconditions, or summaries as new.

minimal_distinguishing_experiment.question: Can the relevant circuit-to-consumer relation be derived or localized with less manual information than an expressive modular specification?
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.design: Freeze one state/domain/identity relationship case and a language-neutral obligation. Give CIVER the smallest equivalent property on a native circuit or a predeclared charged adaptation. Give BindCheck every role and policy input explicitly. Report property and adapter size, authoring and correction time, runtime, grade, and effect/state localization.
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.distinguishing_outcome: Artifact-derived association with materially less manual implementation information, or a diagnosis unavailable under equal inputs; otherwise the contribution narrows to engineering integration.

works.name: CCC-Check
works.title: Language-Agnostic Detection of Computation-Constraint Inconsistencies in ZKP Programs via Value Inference
works.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2026
actual_overlap: Relates prover computation to verifier constraints through value inference and abstract interpretation.
Detects under- and overconstrained computation-constraint inconsistencies.
Consumes CirC IR; the inspected author-hosted paper states that CirC frontends include ZoKrates, Noir, and Circom.
Can overlap producer defects beyond occurrence counting.
assumptions_and_inputs: Exact compatibility with the pinned Noir/ACIR revisions was not established.
The retained pinned build attempt was unavailable as a runnable comparison, which is a construction limitation rather than a miss.
A fair run must separate computation-constraint findings from consumer-only relationship findings.
works.artifact_status: Official artifact repository inspected; prior bounded build did not establish a runnable target path; not executed in Step 18.
works.unresolved_gap: CCC-Check may detect producer defects missed by occurrence and extent rules. Exact overlap on the exposed producer cases requires a compatible pinned run.
works.prohibited_inference: Do not claim computation-constraint consistency, language-agnostic ZKP IR analysis, or value inference as new; do not assume CCC-Check misses Payy from a build failure.

minimal_distinguishing_experiment.question: Does a circuit-to-consumer analysis add value beyond a language-agnostic computation-constraint checker?
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.design: Use one producer computation/constraint mutant with consumer fixed and one consumer-only state/role mutant with byte-identical producer computation and constraints. Run CCC-Check on a supported native input or predeclare a charged adapter. Separate producer inconsistency detection from consumer relationship localization and validate all candidates identically.
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.distinguishing_outcome: Credit every producer inconsistency CCC-Check finds. A controlled consumer-only relationship diagnosis with unchanged producer bytes would isolate additional boundary information.

works.name: SmartAxe
works.title: SmartAxe: Detecting Cross-Chain Vulnerabilities in Bridge Smart Contracts via Fine-Grained Static Analysis
works.venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering, FSE 2024
actual_overlap: Analyzes relationships across multiple smart-contract programs instead of treating each contract in isolation.
Normalizes heterogeneous access-control checks, infers protected resources, and builds cross-chain control-flow and data-flow graphs.
Detects cross-bridge semantic inconsistency and is therefore a close structural analogue for a cross-component semantic join.
assumptions_and_inputs: The method assumes paired bridge-contract semantics; Payy is not such a pair and the exposed same-chain WarpToad fixture may not satisfy the native pairing assumptions.
An inapplicable case must remain not applicable rather than a miss.
A strongest simple graph-composition adaptation must receive the same identities and mappings as the full arm.
works.artifact_status: Official artifact index inspected; a runnable downloadable target setup was not established in the retained construction attempt; not executed in Step 18.
works.unresolved_gap: Native applicability and adaptation cost must be established on a genuine paired bridge before comparative conclusions.
works.prohibited_inference: Do not claim cross-program semantic joining, protected-resource association, or graph alignment as new; do not score a non-pair as a SmartAxe miss.

minimal_distinguishing_experiment.question: Is the typed circuit-consumer join more than a domain-specific instance of cross-program semantic alignment?
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.design: Run SmartAxe natively on a permitted paired bridge if available and construct a strongest-simple-composition baseline using the same extracted producer/consumer identities. Freeze role/domain/state swaps and no-op renamings; charge all pairing, adapter, and label work.
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.distinguishing_outcome: Separate proof-specific producer semantics from generic graph alignment. If a simple alignment matches the relational diagnostics, narrow the contribution.

works.name: ELSA
works.title: Augmenting Multi-Technique Static Analysis with Large Language Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
actual_overlap: The official abstract describes Ensemble LLM-assisted Static Analysis, combining LLM-assisted individual analyzers with an analyzer ensemble.
It describes constraint-guided neural semantic reasoning and conflict resolution among analyzer outputs.
It reports evaluation on three open-source datasets plus self-constructed Zero-Knowledge Proof-based smart contracts.
The stated semantic-integration objective makes ELSA a closest-work obligation for BindCheck's positioning.
assumptions_and_inputs: Only the official conference abstract and proceedings DOI were available for this bounded refresh.
No primary full paper, artifact, model, prompt, benchmark, stochastic configuration, or cost record was inspected.
The abstract does not reveal enough to determine whether ELSA models circuit constraints, consumer semantics, or their exact relation.
works.full_text_status: Not primary-sourced or inspected. The official abstract was inspected; DOI resolution/full text was inaccessible in the bounded audit.
works.artifact_status: No primary artifact was located or inspected. No model baseline was selected or invented.
works.unresolved_gap: Exact overlap with proof-to-execution relationship defects cannot be determined from the abstract. Both overlap and non-overlap remain unresolved.
works.prohibited_inference: Do not state that ELSA is contract-only, lacks circuit semantics, misses the target, proves BindCheck novel, or proves BindCheck non-novel from the abstract alone.

minimal_distinguishing_experiment.question: Can a reproducible neuro-symbolic ensemble identify and localize the same producer-consumer relationship defects under a fixed information and cost budget?
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.design: Only after obtaining the primary full paper and artifact, freeze models, prompts, benchmark inputs, stochastic settings, token/model cost, and repetition policy. Give ELSA and BindCheck the same exposed source bundle, including byte-identical producers with paired consumer role/domain/state mutations. Score relationship localization, irrelevant warnings, manual information, and E1-to-E4 validation identically.
minimal_distinguishing_experiment.distinguishing_outcome: A relationship-specific diagnosis attributable to both producer constraints and consumer semantics under equal inputs. If inputs or labels differ, the result is not a capability comparison.

primary_sources.access_note: Identifier recorded; resolver/full text was not accessible during the bounded audit.
